steps.summary: Deleting parts was NOT blocked by Ready status — no refusal message appeared and no status change back to Draft was needed. Each delete opened an in-page "Confirm" modal reading verbatim: 'Delete the part "fwrd81-n3 RD Bench Ticket RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone.' (and the same for Part B); I confirmed with "Delete part" each time and the table refreshed, dropping Part A ($187.50 row) then Part B, leaving 'No parts on this ticket yet.' Archiving required NO confirmation: clicking "Archive ticket" archived instantly and the button became "Unarchive ticket". Final detail page for RD-1017 'fwrd81-n3 RD Bench Ticket RD Bench Ticket' shows Status "Ready" plus an "Archived" badge, parts table empty, and actions "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed"/"Unarchive ticket". The default tickets list (archived excluded, 13 total) does NOT contain RD-1017; ticking "Show archived" (15 total) reveals it as 'RD-1017 | fwrd81-n3 RD Bench Ticket RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer Ltd | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-22'.
